old_title: HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile Pricing and Features: What You Get
old_content:
Quick answer: HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile offers an all-in-one legal AI solution for law firms, trusted by over 17,000 legal teams. It provides a free plan for basic AI chat usage and paid plans for Legal AI Chat starting at $30 per user per month (for the Starter plan). Its eFirm practice management system is priced per seat, though I could not find specific pricing details for eFirm on the pages checked.

Last checked: November 17, 2026. Based on HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile's official website and pricing pages. Prices and features change, so confirm details on the official site before you buy. How prices are checked | Report a mistake

HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile is designed for lawyers, in-house teams, founders, and students, with mobile apps available on iOS and Android. The platform provides AI-powered drafting, research, and document review capabilities.

HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile pricing and features presents an all-in-one solution for legal professionals. This tool aims to simplify legal work through its AI chatbot and eFirm practice management system. Understanding its cost and capabilities is crucial for freelancers and small teams considering adoption.

  • Pricing Model: Usage-based for Legal AI Chat, per seat for eFirm.
  • Platforms: iOS, Android.
  • Best for: Lawyers, in-house teams, founders, students, law firms.

HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile: Plans and Pricing

HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile offers two distinct products with separate pricing models. Legal AI Chat is priced based on usage, making it accessible for individuals working with legal texts. EFirm, on the other hand, is priced per seat, catering to firms managing matters, billing, and clients. Institutions can integrate both under a unified Legal OS proposal.

Here is a breakdown of the available plans and pricing information I found:

Plan Pricing Model Key Features / Credits Notes
Free Plan (Legal AI Chat) Free Basic AI Chat usage Allows users to try AI capabilities for research, drafting, and reviewing legal documents.
Starter (Legal AI Chat) $30 per user per month 100 credits/month Billed monthly, cancel anytime. I found that Starter members can get 180 credits for $50 as a top-up.
Boutique (Legal AI Chat) $60 per user per month (Specific features not detailed beyond pricing) Requires a minimum of 2 seats per workspace.
Student Program (Legal AI Chat) $15 per month 60 credits/month A special program designed for students.
Pro / Business (Legal AI Chat) I could not find pricing on the pages checked Mentioned as "Most Popular" These tiers are likely designed for more extensive usage, with details available upon inquiry.
EFirm Priced per seat Practice management for matters, billing, and clients. I could not find specific pricing details for eFirm plans on the pages checked.

Legal AI Chat

Legal AI Chat is designed for research, drafting, and reviewing legal documents. It is targeted at lawyers, in-house teams, founders, and students. The pricing is based on how much AI you use.

This feature allows me to read any document, draft any contract, and get a clear answer to any legal question, under the law that actually governs it. The platform offers a wide array of templates, with over 631 available for various legal tasks.

The paid plans for Legal AI Chat start from $0.31 per credit. The site also highlights that a plan generally costs less per credit than any top-up.

EFirm

EFirm is a practice management system for firms. It is priced per seat and is for firms running matters, billing, and clients. It functions as your firm's Legal AI Twin and Practice Management System for drafting, billing, and winning. I could not find specific pricing details for the eFirm plans beyond the per-seat model on the pages checked.

Key Features for Freelancers and Small Teams

HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile offers several features that can benefit independent professionals and small legal teams.

AI Chat for Drafting and Research

The core of HAQQ Legal AI is its AI Chat. This feature allows users to draft legal documents, review contracts, and conduct legal research. It aims to provide clear answers to legal questions, grounded in the governing law.

The tool can read any document and draft any contract, using the Justinian AI Engine. This engine understands legal questions, targets exact jurisdictions, and crafts answers backed by verified case law and line-by-line citations.

Document Review and Risk Assessment

HAQQ Legal AI can review documents for compliance gaps. It analyzes contracts and identifies potential risks, offering capabilities for full contract risk review and redlining. This is invaluable for ensuring agreements are sound and meet legal requirements across various jurisdictions. If you are comparing other options in this space, see my breakdown of Xero and Agent Vault AI Tool.

Jurisdictional Targeting

The Justinian AI Engine's ability to understand legal questions and target specific jurisdictions is a critical feature. It crafts answers backed by verified case law and line-by-line citations, ensuring precision and relevance, especially when dealing with multi-region coverage across MENA, Europe, North America, South America, Asia-Pacific, and Africa.

Mobile Accessibility

The availability of HAQQ Legal AI on mobile platforms (iOS and Android) is a significant advantage. This allows legal professionals to access powerful AI tools and practice management features on the go. It ensures productivity is not tied to a desktop, enabling work from anywhere.

Practice Management with EFirm

The eFirm component serves as a comprehensive legal operating system for firms. It helps manage matters, contracts, documents, hearings, tasks, calendars, financial aspects, KYC, leads, and emails. This integrated approach simplifies daily operations for legal teams.

Security and Governance

HAQQ Legal AI emphasizes security and governance with features like Cross-Matter Isolation, Audit Trails, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and Anonymization. These measures are designed to protect sensitive legal data and ensure compliance.

Context and Knowledge Management

The platform helps manage a firm's institutional memory through features like RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) playbooks, policies, memos, templates, precedents, clause libraries, and matter history. This ensures that internal knowledge is used effectively for legal work.

Data and Integrations

HAQQ Legal AI integrates with live legal sources, secure web search, statutes, case law, gazettes, regulatory databases, and intellectual property offices like USPTO, EUIPO, and WIPO. This broad access to information supports thorough legal research and analysis.

HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile: Pros and Cons

Here's a look at the advantages and potential drawbacks based on the information available.

✅ Free plan available for Legal AI Chat, offering entry-level access to AI capabilities.
✅ Mobile apps for iOS and Android ensure on-the-go productivity and access.
✅ Jurisdiction-specific AI provides targeted and accurate legal insights backed by citations.
✅ Comprehensive legal AI capabilities including drafting, research, document review, and risk assessment.
✅ Integrated practice management system (eFirm) for matters, billing, and clients.
✅ Solid security features like Cross-Matter Isolation and Audit Trails.
✅ Extensive knowledge management and integration with live legal sources.

❌ Detailed pricing for eFirm was not found on the pages checked.
❌ Specific usage limits or tiers for the free AI Chat plan were not documented.
❌ Integration details with other common legal tech tools were not explicitly found.

Who Should Skip HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile?

Professionals who only need basic document editing without AI assistance might find HAQQ Legal AI to be overkill. Similarly, those who do not require specialized legal AI features or practice management tools may not benefit. If your workflow is heavily reliant on integrations with specific legacy systems, like those found in some larger firms, you would need to investigate compatibility.

HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile offers a powerful suite of tools for legal professionals, with a notable free tier for its AI Chat, making advanced legal AI accessible for initial use.

Questions people ask

What is the lowest price for HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile?

The lowest price mentioned for HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile is for the Legal AI Chat usage-based model, starting from $0.31 per credit. The "Starter" plan for Legal AI Chat is $30 per user per month.

Does HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile have a free plan?

Yes, HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile offers a free plan for its Legal AI Chat feature, allowing users to try its AI capabilities.

What platforms does HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile support?

HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile is available on the App Store for iOS devices and Google Play for Android devices.
